mechanical.package: 0805 ceramic chip antenna (3.2 x 1.6 x 1.3 mm)

keepout_mm.conditions: Vendor reference layout (2450AT18A100-EB1SMA evaluation board): the antenna sits in a 6.5 mm 'No Ground' region at the board end, spanning the full 20 mm board width; the ground plane starts 6.5 mm away along the antenna axis. This is a copper/ground keepout stated by the vendor, not a component-to-component spacing.

source.section: Typical Electrical Characteristics -- Test Board layout

design_notes.note: The antenna must sit in a ground-free region: the vendor's own evaluation board places it in a 6.5 mm 'No Ground' cutout at the end of a 39.5 mm ground plane. Ground pour, and by extension any grounded copper or component, encroaching on that region detunes the antenna.

Leave slots for a 'pi' (shunt-series-shunt) matching network next to the feed point. The values printed on the datasheet (3.9 nH / 1.0 pF / 2.7 nH) are only valid on Johanson's evaluation board; on any other PCB the matching topology and values must be re-tuned, so the matching-component footprints must exist on the board even if depopulated.

The feed trace from the matching network to the feed point must be a 50 ohm controlled-impedance line; the vendor notes the feedline can be as short as needed, so it should be routed as short as the layout permits.

Passive element with 2 W max CW input power and 50 ohm impedance; peak gain 0.5 dBi typ and average gain -0.5 dBi typ in the XZ-V cut. It radiates whatever the transmitter feeds it, so its emission band is the radio's band, not an independent source.

provenance.notes: 4-page detail specification, printed for P/N 2450AT18A100E-AEC ('E' is a tape-and-reel packaging suffix; S/R are the bulk and reverse-reel variants of the same 2450AT18A100 part). No theta_ja, no junction temperature, no quiescent/operating current: it is a passive ceramic element with no active dissipation, and the vendor publishes none. No rx_sensitivity_dbm -- that belongs to the radio the antenna is attached to, not to the antenna. tx_power_dbm omitted for the same reason; the only power figure given is a 2 W max CW input rating, recorded in design_notes. The 6.5 mm keepout is the vendor's 'No Ground' clearance from its reference layout drawing on page 2, read off the dimensioned figure.
